state:
Goal `core-uuid`: `Core\Uuid::fromBytes`, `Core\Uuid::parse` and `Core\Uuid::toBytes` have all their
feature proofs, and `bun nv proofs --owed` names nothing for them. `Core\Uuid` now has its class card
(`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs`'s `CARD`), and it is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, so the class
half of `help` is done for every member. The cards for `parse`, `fromBytes` and `toBytes` are
rewritten in the plain voice. The cards for `v4`, `v7`, `tryParse` and `toString` are still in the old
essay voice and are rewritten with their slices.

Still owed: `v4`, `v7`, `tryParse` and `toString`. Each owes examples, hostile, perf and a Rust
`covers:` marker. `help` is listed as owed until the binary is rebuilt, and the class card closes it.

next.title: the remaining members, in file order
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs` plus each member's three proof trees.

items.text: **`Core\Uuid::v4`**: examples, hostile, perf, Rust `covers:` on `a_v4_is_canonical_lower_case_hex_with_its_version_and_variant`, and a plain-voice `V4_DOC` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs:148`

**`Core\Uuid::v7`**: the same, with `covers:` on `a_v7_carries_its_version_and_a_clock_that_moves_forward`. Its examples print no fixed value unless they compare two draws, so assert order or shape rather than a UUID. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs:157`

**`Core\Uuid::toString`**: the same, with `covers:` on `the_canonical_form_parses_in_either_case_and_renders_lower`. It is an instance member, so a `.nvst` case needs a `// covers:` marker as well. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs:206`

backlog: A bench over a member that returns a `Core\Uuid` has no scalar to read without calling a second member. `benches/members/core/Uuid/fromBytes.nvs` chains `$total` alone, and the allocation count (1.00 per call) shows the call is not removed. Owner: `benches/members/README.md`.
